description: The donut chart, titled “Task Type,” visually represents the distribution of two primary tasks performed by Agency A in the context of generative AI use in journalism, as detailed in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” The chart is divided into two segments: a large, salmon-pink segment labeled “Article generation (83.2%)” and a smaller, pale-yellow segment labeled “Headline generation (16.8%).” The central white space contains the bolded title “Task Type,” and each segment’s label and percentage are positioned outside the ring, connected by lines to their respective slices. The chart clearly emphasizes the dominance of article generation over headline generation in Agency A’s workflow, with the former accounting for over four-fifths of the tasks. No additional categories, legends, or annotations are present, and the proportions are explicitly labeled, making the distribution immediately interpretable.
